translationRepairs: On guihai, former Yanzhou commissioner Zhao Zaili became commissioner of Xuzhou, and Gao Xingzhou, former Yedu defender and Guangjin prefect, became Henan prefect and defender of the Western Capital.

On guihai, former Yunzhou commissioner Zhao Zaili became commissioner of Xu Prefecture, and Gao Xingzhou, former Yedu defender and Guangjin prefect, became Henan prefect and defender of the Western Capital.
鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou; rendering 許州 as Xu Prefecture avoids confusion with 徐州 without a parenthetical gloss.

On day guihai, Zhao Zaili, former military commissioner of Yanzhou, was made military commissioner of Xuzhou; Gao Xingzhou, former defender of Yedu and prefect of Guangjin, was made prefect of Henan and defender of the Western Capital.

On day guihai, Zhao Zaili, former military commissioner of Yunzhou, was made military commissioner of Xu Prefecture; Gao Xingzhou, former defender of Yedu and prefect of Guangjin, was made prefect of Henan and defender of the Western Capital.
鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou; rendering 許州 as Xu Prefecture avoids confusion with 徐州 without a parenthetical gloss.
Former Cangzhou was redesignated the Deqing army.
Former Chanzhou was redesignated the Deqing army.
澶州 is Chanzhou, whereas Cangzhou is written 滄州.
The former Cangzhou was renamed the Deqing army.
The former Chanzhou was renamed the Deqing army.
澶州 is Chanzhou, whereas Cangzhou is written 滄州.
On the new moon of the tenth winter month, Ceremonial Vice Minister Wei Bi and three others were sent separately to Hua, Pu, Yan, and Cang to inspect flood damage to the crops.
On the new moon of the tenth winter month, Ceremonial Vice Minister Wei Bi and three others were sent separately to Huazhou, Puzhou, Yunzhou, and Chanzhou to inspect flood damage to the crops.
鄆 and 澶 identify Yunzhou and Chanzhou, not Yan and Cang; full prefecture names are clearer than the proposal's bare syllables.

On dingchou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and took up arms. Western Capital defender Gao Xingzhou was made southern field commander to lead troops against him, with former Tongzhou commissioner Song Yanyun as deputy and Southern Palace Secretariat Chancellor Zhang Congen as overseer.

On dingchou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and took up arms. Western Capital defender Gao Xingzhou was made southern field commander to lead troops against him, with former Tongzhou commissioner Song Yanyun as deputy and Southern Palace Bureau attendant Zhang Cong'en as overseer.
張從恩 is Zhang Cong'en, and 宣徽南院使 is the Southern Palace Bureau office used elsewhere in this chapter, not a Secretariat chancellorship.
Chongyi, former acting Eastern Capital defender and Henan prefect, already Grand Mentor, was raised to Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou;
Chong'ai, former acting Eastern Capital defender and Henan prefect, already Grand Mentor, was raised to Grand Marshal and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou;
The established English form Chong'ai distinguishes 石重乂 from the different royal kinsman 重裔; the parenthetical duplicate is unnecessary.
Yanzhou commissioner, northern campaign commander, and Palace Guard commander Du Chongwei became Shunguo commissioner at Hengzhou and was also made Vice Grand Councilor;
Yunzhou commissioner, northern campaign commander, and Palace Guard commander Du Chongwei became Shunguo commissioner at Hengzhou and was also made Vice Grand Councilor;
鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou.
Heyang commissioner and Palace Guard chief adjutant Jing Yanguang was made Honorary Grand Marshal, transferred to Yanzhou commissioner, and kept his army command.
Heyang commissioner and Palace Guard chief adjutant Jing Yanguang was made Honorary Grand Marshal, transferred to Yunzhou commissioner, and kept his army command.
鄆州 is Yunzhou, not Yanzhou.
On bingwu, an edict declared: "Deng, Tang, Sui, and E have much unused land. Households may reclaim it as they choose, with labor and tax levies waived for five years."
On bingwu, an edict declared: "Deng, Tang, Sui, and Ying have much unused land. Households may reclaim it as they choose, with labor and tax levies waived for five years."
郢州 is Yingzhou, represented as Ying in the parallel list.
An edict granted the Hushan shrine in Huyang County, Tang Prefecture, the title "Spirit of Manifest Compliance of Mount Liao."
An edict granted the Liaoshan shrine in Huyang County, Tang Prefecture, the title "Spirit of Manifest Compliance of Mount Liao."
蓼山 is Liaoshan or Mount Liao; Hushan is a mistranslation.
On bingxu in the intercalary month, War Bureau Director Si Tuyi became Right Remonstrance Censor.
On bingxu in the intercalary month, War Bureau Director Situ Xu became Right Remonstrance Censor.
司徒 is the compound surname Situ and 詡 is the given name Xu.
An edict renamed the Xuandu Xuaming Gate Zhufeng Gate;
An edict renamed the Yedu Xuaming Gate Zhufeng Gate;
鄴都 is Yedu; Xuandu is an erroneous reading.
That spring drought struck Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shaan, Ru, Heng, and Chen, while locusts ravaged Yan, Cao, Dan, Bo, Xiang, and Ming.
That spring drought struck Yedu, Fengxiang, Yanzhou, Shaanzhou, Ruzhou, Hengzhou, and Chenzhou, while locusts ravaged Yunzhou, Caozhou, Chanzhou, Bozhou, Xiangzhou, and Mingzhou.
The second list contains 鄆州 and 澶州, Yunzhou and Chanzhou; spelling out each prefecture makes the two similar lists unambiguous.
In the sixth month, on dingsi, Yanzhou commissioner Sang Weihan became Jinchang army commissioner, and former Xuzhou commissioner An Shenqi became Yanzhou commissioner.
In the sixth month, on dingsi, Yanzhou commissioner Sang Weihan became Jinchang Army commissioner, and former Xu Prefecture commissioner An Shenqi became Yanzhou commissioner.
許州 is Xu Prefecture, distinct from 徐州; spelling out Prefecture is cleaner than the proposal's parenthetical disambiguation.
